description: Use when an agent needs price history for a Hyperliquid perp or HIP-3 market (xyz:TSLA). Input: coin, interval (1m-1M, default 1h), limit (1-500, default 100), optional start/end (ISO date or unix). Output: JSON candles (time, open, high, low, close, volume, trades) plus summary: change %, high/low, volume, annualized realized volatility. Unknown coin: 400, not charged. Example: ?coin=ETH&interval=1h&limit=24 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol (BTC, ETH, kPEPE) or HIP-3 dex:COIN (xyz:TSLA). Not listed or delisted: 400 before payment (not charged)

end.description: End time: ISO date/time or unix seconds/ms (default now)

limit.description: Number of candles, newest last (1-500, default 100)

start.description: Start time: ISO date/time or unix seconds/ms (default end - limit x interval)

name: hl_candles
title: Hyperliquid OHLCV candles (perps and HIP-3 markets) with range, change and realized volatility
